subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should provider-specific normalization and unavailable-configured-ref callbacks become permanent API in `openclaw/plugin-sdk/provider-web-search`?
rationale: The Ollama bug needs a shared seam, but repository policy makes the generality and permanence of exported plugin APIs a maintainer-owned decision.

options.title: Approve the narrow optional hooks
options.body: Keep the backward-compatible hooks after the Ollama fallback regression is repaired and covered.

options.title: Use a named constrained helper
options.body: Replace generic callbacks with a narrower shared credential-policy helper before merge.
